AttachNodes.description_en: Adds Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances as compute nodes to Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) clusters
AttachNodes.description_zh: 将不属于E-HPC的ECS添加到E-HPC集群，作为E-HPC集群计算节点进行管理和操作

AttachSharedStorages.description_en: Attaches shared storage to an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster

CreateCluster.description_en: Create a pay-as-you-go or subscription cluster
CreateCluster.description_zh: 创建一个按量付费或者预付费（包年包月）集群

CreateJob.description_en: Creates a job for a cluster
CreateJob.description_zh: 为指定集群创建一个作业

CreateNodes.description_en: Creates compute nodes for an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster in a batch
CreateNodes.description_zh: 批量给E-HPC集群创建计算节点

CreateQueue.description_en: Creates a queue for an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
CreateQueue.description_zh: 为指定的E-HPC集群创建队列

CreateReservedNodePool.description_en: Creates a reserved node pool. A reserved node pool reserves a batch of active IP addresses from a vSwitch. It maps each IP address to a hostname based on a rule and maintains the resources for the node pool. When you use the reserved node pool to scale nodes, the corresponding resources are allocated or released
CreateReservedNodePool.description_zh: 创建预设节点池。预设节点池会预占用vSwitch下的批量可用IP，一一映射到根据规则生成的主机名上，并维护该映射表对应的节点池资源。当后续使用预设节点池来扩容/缩容节点时，会实际占用/释放对应预设节点池的资源

CreateUsers.description_en: Adds one or more users to a specified cluster
CreateUsers.description_zh: 为指定集群新增一个或多个用户

DeleteCluster.description_en: Releases an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster

DeleteNodes.description_en: Deletes compute nodes from an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster at a time
DeleteNodes.description_zh: 批量删除E-HPC集群的计算节点

DeleteQueues.description_en: Deletes queues from an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster

DeleteReservedNodePool.description_en: Deletes the specified reserved node pool
DeleteReservedNodePool.description_zh: 删除指定的预设节点池

DeleteUsers.description_zh: 删除指定集群的一个或多个用户

DescribeAddonTemplate.description_en: Queries the details of an addon template
DescribeAddonTemplate.description_zh: 查询自定义服务组件模板详情

DetachSharedStorages.description_en: Unmounts shared storage from the mount directory of a cluster
DetachSharedStorages.description_zh: 卸载指定集群的挂载目录的共享存储资源

GetAddon.description_en: Queries the details of an installed addon
GetAddon.description_zh: 查询已安装的自定义服务组件详情

GetCluster.description_en: Query information about a specified E-HPC cluster

GetCommonLogDetail.description_en: Query logs based on a request ID. Logs for specific actions can be queried thanks to an Action-Stage-Method three-layer log splitting structure
GetCommonLogDetail.description_zh: 根据具体操作的请求ID查询日志，通过将操作日志拆分成 Action-Stage-Method 三层日志结构，能够详细罗列出各操作涉及到的详细步骤日志

GetJob.description_en: Obtains the details of a job
GetJob.description_zh: 获取指定作业的详细信息

GetJobLog.description_en: Queries the output logs of a job, including standard output logs and error output logs
GetJobLog.description_zh: 查询作业运行后的输出日志，包括标准输出日志和错误输出日志

GetQueue.description_en: Query the details of a specified queue in an E-HPC cluster
GetQueue.description_zh: 查询E-HPC集群指定队列的详情

GetUser.description_en: Queries the details of a cluster user

InstallSoftwares.description_en: Install software for the specified cluster

ListAddonTemplates.description_zh: 查询支持的自定义服务组件模板列表

ListAddons.description_en: Queries installed addons of an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
ListAddons.description_zh: 查看已安装的自定义服务组件列表

ListAvailableFileSystems.description_en: Queries the file systems that can be attached in a region
ListAvailableFileSystems.description_zh: 查询指定地域可挂载的文件系统列表

ListAvailableImages.description_en: Queries images that are available for Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) clusters
ListAvailableImages.description_zh: 获取E-HPC集群可用镜像列表

ListClusters.description_en: Queries the list of all clusters in each region under your account
ListClusters.description_zh: 查询用户账号中在每个地域拥有的所有集群的列表

ListCommonLogs.description_en: Queries the logs of a cluster that are generated within a time range
ListCommonLogs.description_zh: 查询指定集群某一段时间内的日志列表

ListInstalledSoftwares.description_en: Queries the installed software of a cluster

ListJobs.description_en: Queries the list of jobs in a specified cluster
ListJobs.description_zh: 查询指定集群中的作业列表

ListNodes.description_en: Queries the nodes of an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster

ListQueues.description_en: Queries queues in an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
ListQueues.description_zh: 查询指定E-HPC集群的队列列表

ListRegions.description_en: Queries the available regions for the product
ListRegions.description_zh: 查询产品支持的地域列表

ListSharedStorages.description_en: Queries the shared storage that is attached to a cluster
ListSharedStorages.description_zh: 查询指定集群下已挂载的共享存储信息

ListSoftwares.description_en: Queries the software that can be installed in an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
ListSoftwares.description_zh: 查询E-HPC支持安装的软件列表

ListUsers.description_en: Queries the users of a cluster
ListUsers.description_zh: 查询指定集群的用户列表信息

StopJobs.description_en: Stops uncompleted jobs in a batch in an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
StopJobs.description_zh: 批量停止E-HPC集群中处于“未完成”状态的作业

UninstallSoftwares.description_en: Uninstalls software systems from an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
UninstallSoftwares.description_zh: 卸载E-HPC集群中已安装的指定软件

UpdateCluster.description_en: Modify the basic information of a specified cluster
UpdateCluster.description_zh: 修改指定集群的配置信息

UpdateNodes.description_en: Updates the configurations of compute nodes in an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
UpdateNodes.description_zh: 批量更新E-HPC集群计算节点配置

UpdateQueue.description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified queue in an E-HPC cluster
UpdateQueue.description_zh: 修改E-HPC集群指定队列的配置信息

UpdateUser.description_en: Updates the information of a specified cluster user, including properties such as user group and password
UpdateUser.description_zh: 更新指定集群用户的信息，包括用户组、密码等属性
